definition: Is This What We Want? is an album by various artists released on 25 February 2025 through Virgin Music Group.
details: It consists of ambient noise recorded in recording studios, protesting the use of unlicensed copyrighted work to train artificial intelligence. The track titles form the sentence "The British Government must not legalise music theft to benefit AI companies". Profits from the album go toward the UK charity Help Musicians.
